correctness.rationale: At cube vertices each positive convex row attains norm exactly on monochromatic triples, so the norming-face convex hull K is independent of weights. Dual support formula h_K(a)=1-2 min_e min(P_e,N_e) for ||a||1=1. Every six-line proper 2-colouring has 3 base vertices of one colour with zero or one same-colour leaf, checked by all 128 sign vectors independently for each of seven deleted lines (ten proper colourings each). In the zero-leaf case min masses force 3d base+2d leaf ≤1; one-leaf case 6d≤1. Explicit normalized a=(1/5,1/5,1/5,-1/10,-1/10,-1/10,-1/10) saturates d=1/5 and yields radius 1-2/5=3/5. Restore seventh line => all 128 sign vertices norm attaining => radius 1. This is exact finite exhaustive hypergraph argument plus continuous LP support bound, not sampling of arbitrary coefficients.
